title: Baidu Integrates Dodo and Baidu Daze Teams to Unify the Advancement of AI Office Intelligent Agent Business

content_html:
Baidu has initiated the integration of its internal office AI agent, Dodo, with the Baidu Dazi team. The relevant R&D personnel and resources will be merged into Baidu Dazi, achieving unification between internal office assistants and external office AI product offerings. This means Baidu will further concentrate its resources to advance its AI office agent business and accelerate its layout in the intelligent agent office market.

According to the information, Dodo was previously mainly serving Baidu's internal employees as an office AI agent tool. Employees can issue tasks to Dodo through Baidu's internal communication software such as Liu, web or client interfaces, for office scenarios like meeting organization, document processing, and email queries. It can also access knowledge bases and development platforms, supporting code submission and requirement management in the R&D process.

Baidu Dazi was launched in March this year, an intelligent agent platform launched by Baidu for personal and enterprise office scenarios. Users only need to describe their work goals, and Baidu Dazi can complete task decomposition, information search, document processing, web operations, and result delivery. It also supports continuous task execution across files and applications. Currently, products such as Baidu Search, Baidu Netdisk, Baidu Maps, Baidu Ability Reach, and the Woodcutting Solutions have been integrated through skills, providing support for scenarios such as research analysis, content creation, PPT generation, and enterprise collaboration.

In July this year, Baidu Dazi Enterprise Edition was officially released, supporting enterprises to share skills, project context, and workflow outcomes, enabling unified management of knowledge assets, business processes, and execution capabilities. It has already been implemented in multiple industry clients. According to Baidu, the daily number of questions asked on Baidu Dazi has increased 20 times since its launch, and it has achieved leading performance in intelligent agent evaluations such as PinchBench and DeepResearchBench.

After the integration, Baidu Dazi will become a unified office AI agent platform covering internal office, personal productivity, and enterprise collaboration scenarios. The practical capabilities of Dodo in scenarios such as meeting management, knowledge base access, R&D collaboration, and team skill reuse will gradually be integrated into Baidu Dazi Enterprise Edition, further enhancing its ability to organize knowledge accumulation and execute complex workflows.

As AI Agents evolve from single assistants to enterprise-level productivity platforms, office AI agents are becoming a new direction for competition among technology companies. This integration of internal technical resources by Baidu aims to build a smart office ecosystem covering individuals, organizations, and enterprises.

content_html_zh:
百度已启动内部办公AI代理Dodo与百度打子团队的整合。 相关研发人员和资源将并入百度打子，实现内部办公助手与外部办公AI产品的统一。 这意味着百度将进一步集中资源推进AI代办公业务，加速布局智能代办公市场。

资料显示，Dodo此前主要作为办公AI代理工具服务于百度内部员工。 员工可以通过Liu、Web或客户端等百度内部通讯软件向Dodo下发任务，用于会议组织、文档处理、邮件查询等办公场景。 它还可以访问知识库和开发平台，支持研发过程中的代码提交和需求管理。

百度打子于今年3月上线，是百度针对个人和企业办公场景推出的智能座席平台。 用户只需要描述自己的工作目标，百度打子就可以完成任务分解、信息搜索、文档处理、网页操作和结果交付。 它还支持跨文件和应用程序的连续任务执行。 目前，百度搜索、百度网盘、百度地图、百度智通、木刻解决方案等产品已通过技能集成，为研究分析、内容创作、PPT生成、企业协作等场景提供支持。

今年7月，百度打字企业版正式发布，支持企业共享技能、项目背景和工作流程成果，实现知识资产、业务流程和执行能力的统一管理。 目前已在多个行业客户中实施。 据百度介绍，自上线以来，百度打字每日提问量增长了20倍，在PinchBench、DeepResearchBench等智能代理评测中取得领先表现。

整合后，百度打子将成为覆盖内部办公、个人生产力、企业协作场景的统一办公AI代理平台。 Dodo在会议管理、知识库接入、研发协作、团队技能复用等场景的实用能力将逐步融入百度打子企业版，进一步增强其组织知识积累和执行复杂工作流程的能力。

随着AI智能体从单一助手向企业级生产力平台演进，办公AI智能体正在成为科技公司竞争的新方向。 此次百度整合内部技术资源，旨在打造覆盖个人、组织、企业的智慧办公生态圈。
